reason: With a flat sale, the 15CA/15CB paperwork and CA hunting is exactly what I don't have time for, and $199 is small against the amount moving. The fee only comes out when the money lands and the CA call is free, so I can try it with little risk.
objection: My Indian bank will still call me or ask me to come in, and then I've paid for a service that doesn't actually save me the trip.
would_change_my_mind: A clear statement, in writing, that my bank will not need me to visit or phone in, ideally with a named example of my bank working this way.
